about: Which transport channel carries which output jack. Read by the output monitor menu and by tests; the shim and the sink keep the same numbers (hardware_stub.c MAIN_PAIR_*, audio-sink.swift OutputJack). Grades: O observed, S static, I inferred, U unknown.

ak4458audio-0.layout: 8 DAC slots of two channels; only the even channel of each slot carries audio, the odd one is padding that carries a full-scale pattern near the top of the band (observed, grade O)

jacks.evidence: AUDIO TEST MODE3 (input to filter to OUT1/2 + MASTER) put the injected signal on channels 12 and 14 only
no test mode isolates this pair; MODE1 lights all four pairs and the slot order is regular (reversed against the jack numbers)
AUDIO TEST MODE2 (input to send DAC to return ADC to OUT7-8) put the signal on channels 0 and 2 only
the AK4452 playback stream carries the input in MODE1 and MODE2 and is silent in MODE3

audio_test.mode1: IN -> OUT 1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8, HP OUT: all four master pairs and PHONES carry the input
audio_test.mode2: send DAC -> return ADC -> OUT7-8: master channels 0/2 and PHONES
audio_test.mode3: analog filter -> OUT1/2 + MASTER: master channels 12/14 only
audio_test.limit: the LIMIT button drives GPIO5_IO06 (1 = limiter on, grade I)
audio_test.how: ./sp16 build --name X --research --audio file --app-arg testmode, run with --dev-overlay DIR holding input.wav (and pcm-port-channels containing 0:16), press HOME until PAGE 11, touch the mode buttons at (272,145), (400,145), (528,145) and LIMIT at (656,145)

transport.default_channels: ak4458audio-0 channels 12..15, as before (the WAV is unchanged)
transport.all_channels: set SP16_PCM_PORT_CHANNELS=0:16 in the guest environment, or put 0:16 in <dev-overlay>/pcm-port-channels; the sink then still writes channels 12..15 to the WAV and offers every channel to the monitor
